Content: An unstretched ideal spring hangs vertically from a fixed support. A `0.4` `text(kg)` object is then attached to the lower end of the spring. The object is pulled down to a distance of `0.35` `text(m)` below the unstretched position and released from rest at time `t=0`. A graph of the subsequent vertical position `y` of the lower end of the spring as a function of `t` is given above, where `y=0` when the spring was initially unstretched.
